The 16 target names/ISO-level identities match the source features. This is identity/center evidence, not footprint or legal boundary proof.
source_applicability_finding.neighbor_families: The complete retained original UKR ADM1 (27 features) and ROU ADM1 (42 features) were compared. The source-key join reports 68 UKR contacts and zero ROU key contacts, with no original vector mismatches or ties. This is a bounded retained-family comparison, not an open-world present-day competitor census; UKR-contact rows remain distinct and are not cleared by MDA source matches.

assessment: A source-specific positive route is reasonable for only the 1,853 MDA-only keys whose centers fall in a unique archived source target. The original upstream MDA source is a plausible location witness because the consumed target IDs/names and the archived feature identities align, but the humanitarian source vintage does not independently establish current legal or cadastral boundaries. Do not promote the 46 MDA+UKR contacts, 65 MDA-only nonmatches, or 22 UKR-contact nonmatches through this conclusion. Keep the full 1,986-key denominator and exact partitions. Before any repair claim, the proposed subset still needs actual source-evidence joins, whole-target physical checks, native diagnostics/authority, current selected-owner conservation, and independent final-head review under the ordinary contract.
